rules.name: Rules baseline (depth-4 tree)
rules.description: Segment rules: a depth-4 decision tree on amount and category (up to 16 segments), each flagged when its historical fraud rate exceeds the threshold. What a fraud team could deploy today.

logreg.name: Logistic regression
logreg.description: Linear, fully interpretable baseline with class weighting.

rf.name: Random forest
rf.description: Bagged trees with balanced subsampling; robust, few assumptions.

mlp.name: Neural network (MLP)
mlp.description: Two hidden layers on one-hot, scaled inputs with early stopping; no class weighting (unsupported), thresholded on validation like the others.

lgbm.name: LightGBM
lgbm.description: Gradient boosted trees with native categorical handling and class weighting.

xgb.name: XGBoost
xgb.description: Gradient boosted trees (histogram method) as a second boosting implementation.

protected.decision: Exclude age and gender from the production model: the precision cost is negligible and the regulatory/reputational risk is not.
